extraction_method.class_order: canonical comma10k [Road=0, Lane=1, Undrivable=2, Movable=3, MyCar=4]
extraction_method.per_frame_boundary: count class pixels not surviving a 4-connected cross binary erosion with a constant-false image border
extraction_method.aggregation: sum area pixels and boundary pixels across all n96 frames, then compute boundary_pixels / area_pixels

dag_feed.statement: W_birth,c is proportional to (P/A)_c; Lane is approximately 8.9 times Movable; absolute lambda_c/delta remains owed to a live flow sweep.

epistemic_status.ratio: DERIVED from MEASURED n96 GT geometry
epistemic_status.efficacy_caveat: Frozen n96 islands were already present at CE (~75-94% GT) and flat-within-noise, while the mod32cap clean baseline islands were deliberately unborn because lane not-static initialization was a NO-OP and growth losses were OFF. This receipt does not show that firing the lever improves d_seg or score. Frozen data did not confirm a saddle-node or hysteresis; only an operator-authorized live resumed up/down W_birth ramp can measure efficacy and the absolute threshold.
